events.title: Supply Convoy Attacked
events.text: A supply convoy bound for coalition forces has been ambushed by Scourge forces. How do you respond?

choices.text: Send reinforcements (lose supplies, gain approval)
Abandon convoy (lose approval, save resources)

events.title: Heroic Stand
events.text: Coalition forces have held a breach against overwhelming odds. The ${heroArmy.name} led the defense.

choices.text: Publicize the victory (gain fervor across the coalition)
Rotate forces (trade fervor for reorganization)

events.title: Diplomatic Crisis
events.text: Tensions rise between coalition members over resource allocations and war priorities. ${favored.name} is demanding preferential treatment.

choices.text: Favor ${favored.name}
Maintain equal treatment

events.title: Scourge Advance
events.text: Scourge forces are advancing on a Nexus Dominion relay station.

choices.text: Stand and fight (battle risk, potential victory)
Tactical retreat (lose cohesion, save forces)
Scorched earth (lose supplies, damage Scourge)

events.title: Resource Discovery
events.text: A cache of coalition supplies and salvage has been discovered.

choices.text: Secure immediately (gain supplies)
Share with all empires (gain approval)

events.title: Desertion Crisis
events.text: Reports of desertions are increasing across coalition fleets and garrisons.

choices.text: Boost supplies and equipment (lose resources)
Propaganda campaign (gain fervor, lose approval)
Crack down (reduce aggravation, lose approval)

events.name: Lobbyist Pressure
events.description: Powerful lobbyists from various factions are pressuring the council. How should you respond?

choices.text: Accept their support (gain momentum, lose legitimacy)
Reject their influence (lose momentum, gain legitimacy)

events.name: Public Forum Requested
events.description: Citizens are demanding a public forum to discuss the law. How do you proceed?

choices.text: Hold an open forum (slow progress, gain legitimacy)
Decline and expedite voting (fast progress, lose legitimacy)

events.name: Expert Panel Consultation
events.description: A panel of experts offers to analyze the law. Should you incorporate their recommendations?

choices.text: Accept all recommendations (high legitimacy, slow progress)
Dismiss the panel (maintain momentum, risk legitimacy)

events.name: Opposition Rally
events.description: A large opposition rally is taking place. How should you respond?

choices.text: Engage with protesters (reduce unrest, slow progress)
Suppress the rally (reduce momentum, increase unrest)

events.name: Economic Impact Report
events.description: An economic analysis reveals potential costs. How do you address these concerns?

choices.text: Fund mitigation programs (slow progress, high legitimacy)
Dismiss concerns as overblown (fast progress, risk backlash)

events.name: Empire Makes Demands
events.description: A major empire demands concessions before supporting the law. What is your response?

choices.text: Grant concessions (gain support, lose some momentum)
Refuse and risk their opposition (maintain vision, risk rejection)

events.name: Last-Minute Amendment Proposed
events.description: A coalition proposes a last-minute amendment. Do you accept it?

choices.text: Accept amendment (high chance of passing, changes law intent)
Reject amendment (maintain original vision, risk failure)

events.name: Abstention Bloc Forms
events.description: Several empires threaten to abstain, risking quorum. How do you respond?

choices.text: Offer incentives (gain votes, lose legitimacy)
Delay vote to build consensus (slow but safer)

events.name: Scandal Threatens Vote
events.description: A scandal related to the law surfaces just before the vote. How do you handle it?

choices.text: Launch investigation (delay vote, preserve legitimacy)
Proceed with vote anyway (risk legitimacy for speed)

activeEvent.title: Diplomatic Crisis
activeEvent.text: Tensions rise between coalition members over resource allocations and war priorities. Synaptic Swarm is demanding preferential treatment.

choices.text: Favor Synaptic Swarm
Maintain equal treatment
